title: ISO/IEC 27001 Compliance Checker
overview: A web-based tool that helps organizations assess their compliance with ISO/IEC 27001 requirements through automated gap analysis and reporting.
approach: Built a comprehensive checklist-based assessment tool that maps organizational controls to ISO 27001 Annex A requirements, providing automated scoring and gap identification.
features: Automated compliance scoring against ISO 27001 Annex A
outcome: Helped organizations identify compliance gaps and prioritize remediation efforts.
lessons: Learned the importance of mapping technical controls to business objectives and making compliance accessible to non-technical stakeholders.

title: BDCTF — Online CTF Platform
overview: A Capture The Flag (CTF) competition platform designed for cybersecurity skill development and competitive challenges.
approach: Designed and developed a full-featured CTF platform with challenge management, real-time scoring, and team competition capabilities.
features: Multiple challenge categories (Web, Crypto, Forensics, Reverse Engineering)
Admin panel for challenge and user management
outcome: Provided a platform for cybersecurity enthusiasts to develop and test practical security skills.
lessons: Gained experience in building secure web applications and understanding common vulnerability patterns from a defender's perspective.

title: Restaurant Management System
overview: A comprehensive desktop application for managing restaurant operations including orders, inventory, and customer management.
approach: Developed a full-stack desktop application with database integration for efficient restaurant operations management.
outcome: Streamlined restaurant operations and improved order processing efficiency.
lessons: Learned the importance of user-centered design and database optimization for business applications.

title: Contact Management System
overview: A web-based application for managing contact information with search, categorization, and export capabilities.
approach: Built a CRUD-based web application with intuitive interface for efficient contact organization and retrieval.
outcome: Improved contact organization and accessibility for users.
lessons: Developed foundational skills in web development and database design.
